uploadPlan.action: Host the full site/ directory over production HTTPS, preserving nested locale routes and control files; use .github/workflows/deploy-site.yml when publishing from GitHub Pages.
Upload App Store screenshots from assets/store/ios and assets/store/ios-localized according to docs/app-store-screenshot-manifest.json.
Push metadata with npm run metadata:ios after public support/privacy URLs and review contact values are set.
Fill App Store Connect privacy, age rating, export compliance, pricing, and review fields using the docs/ evidence files in this handoff.
Run npm run release:store-ready, then npm run build:ios and npm run submit:ios.
